description.narrative: (Rwanda): ..The Inclusive Nutrition and Early Childhood Development (INECD) Activity or Gikuriro Kuri Bose (a well growing child for all) in Kinyarwanda will support the implementation of integrated maternal and child nutrition, Early Childhood Development (ECD), disability inclusion and economic strengthening through savings and lending groups. This activity will work with the Ministry of Health and other government institutions at district, sector, cell, and village levels. Interventions will improve the nutritional status of women, children, and adolescents; improve ECD, child stimulation, and positive parenting; care for children and adults with disabilities; and improve linkages between community and health facilities with strengthened referrals, promotion of antenatal care (ANC) uptake, and promotion of maternal nutrition at health facilities in the ten supported districts. The activity will target a total of 750,000 children under six years of age for both nutrition and ECD services, and 850,000 women of reproductive age. .. ..Under this activity, technical assistance to central and decentralized institutions will be integral to achieve sustainable results. The INECD activity will coordinate with other USAID-funded activities on complementary interventions such as nutrition for lactating and pregnant women, market access to nutritious animal sourced foods, water access and sanitation products, and ANC. $500,000 of funding within this activity contributes to the "Micronutrients" earmark... ..This activity will contribute to a range of outcomes, including promoting peoples' livelihoods; reducing child mortality and child stunting; mitigating domestic conflict; empowering women and girls; and supporting people with disabilities. This activity will contribute to the USAID Mission's Country Development Cooperation Strategy 2020 - 2025 in support of the "improved health outcomes" development objective........... .
